SOC.name: SOC-SC1: Admin Delegation Discovery (S4)
SOC.narrative: Alert on unusual PowerShell execution. Surface factors suggest low severity + low recurrence → suppress. VLD investigates identity_context → discovers admin delegation to contractor. Q recomputes, now temporal_pattern is most uncertain → Saturday 3:14am execution. Two hops flip action from suppress to escalate.
SOC.demo_moment: Watch the action change from suppress to escalate after two reads.

SOC.name: SOC-SC2: Lateral Movement Chain (S6)
SOC.narrative: RDP connection alert. Each factor alone looks normal — moderate severity, first time, standard workstation. But identity (IT admin) + timing (Sunday 2am) + blast_radius (domain controller access) TOGETHER cross the boundary. No single factor changes the answer.
SOC.demo_moment: Three reads, each shifts slightly. The COMBINATION crosses the boundary.

SOC.name: SOC-SC3: Clear Suppress (S1)
SOC.narrative: Windows Update service check. Low severity, high recurrence (seen 47 times), non-critical asset, service account, business hours, no blast radius. VLD correctly does NOT investigate. Margin = 0.99.
SOC.demo_moment: System says "no investigation needed." Conservation in action.

DataOps.name: DO-SC1: Schema Cascade (S4)
DataOps.narrative: ETL pipeline failure on billing system. Surface: pipeline unhealthy, but schema looks stable → auto_resolve. VLD checks schema_stability → discovers MATKL_V2 migration (+340K codes). Q recomputes, dependency_impact now critical → billing + AR + GL all downstream. Action flips to escalate.
DataOps.demo_moment: The root cause is a schema change, not the pipeline itself.

DataOps.name: DO-SC2: Cross-System Propagation (S6)
DataOps.narrative: Data freshness alert on supplier master. Each factor is borderline: pipeline OK but slow, schema recently changed, freshness 22min (SLA 30min), 3 downstream systems. No single factor triggers escalation, but the combination of slow pipeline + recent schema change + tight SLA margin + 3 downstream dependencies crosses the threshold.
DataOps.demo_moment: Three partial shifts. The SLA countdown makes the combination urgent.

DataOps.name: DO-SC3: Routine Pipeline Restart (S1)
DataOps.narrative: Daily refresh pipeline completed with warnings. All factors nominal. Known behavior after maintenance window. VLD does not investigate.

S2P.name: S2P-SC1: Contract Amendment (S3)
S2P.narrative: Invoice $47,200 vs PO $42,000 — 12.4% variance → flag_review. VLD checks contract_compliance → discovers Q3 amendment with 15% price escalation clause. One hop: action changes to auto_approve.
S2P.demo_moment: One read. The contract amendment explains the variance.

S2P.name: S2P-SC2: Supplier Pattern (S4)
S2P.narrative: Invoice from reliable supplier, small variance → auto_approve. But VLD checks receipt_match → partial delivery found. Q recomputes, supplier_reliability now uncertain → check reveals 3 recent partial deliveries. Action: hold pending receipt reconciliation.
S2P.demo_moment: Surface says approve. Investigation finds a pattern of partial deliveries.

S2P.name: S2P-SC3: Clean Three-Way Match (S1)
S2P.narrative: Invoice matches PO and receipt exactly. Known supplier, standard terms. VLD does not investigate.
S2P.demo_moment: Auto-approved in milliseconds. Conservation saves analyst time.

Trading.name: TR-SC1: Thesis Reversal (S4)
Trading.narrative: Trade proposal: buy AAPL. Position size OK, timing neutral → execute. VLD checks thesis_alignment → analyst thesis was "AI hardware cycle" but AAPL guidance just shifted to services. Q recomputes, concentration_risk now relevant → already 8% portfolio weight. Action: hold.
Trading.demo_moment: The thesis changed. Concentration makes it worse.

Trading.name: TR-SC2: Correlation Trap (S3)
Trading.narrative: Buy NVDA, small position → execute. VLD checks correlation_exposure → 0.87 correlation with existing AMD position. Combined exposure exceeds 12% of portfolio in same factor. Action: reduce.
Trading.demo_moment: One read reveals hidden concentration through correlation.

Trading.name: TR-SC3: Clean Entry (S1)
Trading.narrative: Buy thesis-aligned stock, small position, low correlation, good timing. VLD does not investigate.

Purchasing.name: PU-SC1: Demand Spike (S3)
Purchasing.narrative: Reorder trigger on standard item, coverage ratio low → reorder. VLD checks demand_signal → holiday promo starting in 2 weeks, 3x normal demand expected. Standard reorder quantity insufficient. Action: reorder at 3x quantity.
Purchasing.demo_moment: Same action, but the investigation changes the quantity.

Purchasing.name: PU-SC2: Supplier Risk (S4)
Purchasing.narrative: Standard reorder from primary supplier → reorder. VLD checks supplier_capacity → lead time doubled (factory shutdown). Q recomputes, cost_variance now relevant → secondary supplier is 15% cheaper with normal lead time. Action: switch_supplier.
Purchasing.demo_moment: Supplier problem leads to a better alternative.

Purchasing.name: PU-SC3: Stable Replenishment (S1)
Purchasing.narrative: Regular weekly reorder. Demand stable, supplier reliable, cost unchanged, shelf life fine. VLD does not investigate.
